text:
maria: @channel prepping APAC GPU canary rollout next week. We’re blocked by networking quotas (EIP/ENI/VPC/IPv6). Need help escalating across ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1.

aj: what exact numbers are we short on?

maria: current limits: EIP=5, ENI per subnet=250, ENI per instance=15. We plan 120 GPU nodes/account, each node needs 2 ENIs for host networking + infra ENIs, plus NATs. Requesting temporary headroom.

leo: summarize ask and open support cases. I can escalate via TAM. Any approval required for cost? :money_with_wings: 

sarah: tagging finance. We need a spend estimate before greenlighting public IP-heavy burst. How long is the burst?

maria: target 2 weeks of burst to provision canaries then scale down. Rough calc: EIP ~ $0.045/hr when unattached; NAT GW ~ $0.045-$0.06/hr depending on region. Ballpark extra ~$6k/account for 2 weeks.

account-manager: opened support intake and flagged as high-impact. Case 9876543210 created for ap-southeast-1 EIP increase. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=9876543210

aj: also hitting route table limits during subnet automation. Current route-table=102 (limit 100) in one account. Need route-table per VPC and VPC per region increases.

network-bot: auto-detect: vpc-count=12 (limit 20), route-table-count=102 (limit 100) -> route tables slightly over limit. Recommend raising route tables to 250.

leo: request list from Maria so I can file ENI/route-table escalations and talk to TAM. Suggested targets: ENI per subnet 2000, ENI per instance 30, route-tables per VPC 250, VPCs per region 50.

maria: payload I’ll attach to each support case: 
```
Requested increases:
- Elastic IPs: 200 per region (ap-southeast-1, ap-northeast-1)
- ENI per subnet: 2000
- ENI per instance: 30
- VPCs per region: 50
- Route tables per VPC: 250
- IPv6 /56 prefix delegation per account: 4
```

sarah: provisional finance ok to pre-approve up to $7k per account for the 2-week provisioning window, pending final budget-ops signoff.

finance: acknowledged, pls CC budget-ops@redwood.com and include amortized estimate and end date in the ticket.

maria: CC'd budget-ops and pasted Google sheet with calc (internal): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/FAKE-MOCK-LINK

leo: we also need IPAM coordination — add two /48s to central pool to avoid overlap with APAC customers. @aj can you review addressing plan?

aj: will review tonight. For IPv6 we need SLAAC + static assignments for infra (NATs, bastions). Can cloud reserve prefixes so we don’t leak addresses across tenants?

network-bot: reminder: AWS often requests detailed consumption plan for EIP increases >100. Include per-account attachment mapping, lifecycle plan, and rollback.

maria: noted, I'll attach per-account mapping and timelines. Filing detailed cases now. :thumbsup:

aws-support-bot: Case 9876543210 updated by AWS: "We are reviewing your request for EIP limit increases. Additional information requested: per-account attachment plan and justification for >100 EIPs."

maria: AWS asked for per-account attachment mapping. I'll post the mapping doc in #eng-infra and ping once replies are in.

leo: action items: 1) Maria - file cases with arch diagram, CIDR and per-account mapping; 2) Leo - escalate route-table/ENI via TAM and console; 3) Sarah - finish finance pre-approval and CC budget-ops; 4) Aj - review IPAM & IPv6 plan. Hold large-scale provisioning until quotas confirmed.

sarah: noted, no green light until cases are in progress.

maria: filed follow-ups: 9876543210 (EIP ap-southeast-1), 9876544321 (ENI), 9876546789 (IPv6 prefix). Will paste updates here.

aj: thanks, will complete IPAM review tomorrow and flag any overlaps.

leo: thanks all — lean on TAM if AWS asks for production justification. Once quotas are approved, coordinate a staged provisioning run to validate ENI attachment logic. :rocket:
